results.title: Model Context Protocol
results.content: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open protocol that standardizes how applications provide context to large language models.

results.title: Model Context Protocol - Wikipedia
results.content: MCP is a protocol introduced by Anthropic in November 2024 for connecting AI assistants to external tools and data sources.

results.title: Introducing the Model Context Protocol | Anthropic
results.content: MCP is an open standard that lets developers build secure, two-way connections between their data sources and AI-powered tools.

results.title: modelcontextprotocol/servers: Model Context Protocol Servers
results.content: A collection of reference implementations and community-built servers that expose files, databases, git repositories and APIs over MCP.

results.title: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk - npm
results.content: Official TypeScript SDK for the Model Context Protocol. Build servers and clients that speak MCP over stdio or streamable HTTP.
